effects.label: Freeze
effects.description: The recipient cannot move or attack, and Passive Skills are disabled.Active Skill cooldowns are paused.The recipient will take 75% damage from incoming attacks.

levels.text:
INVOKATION
Attacks the 8 enemies with the lowest current HP in a 15m radius, dealing 139 damage. Damage increases by 20% to the target if the target is immune to Crowd Control debuffs. Casts a [Freeze] debuff on the targets, lasting 3s. Frozen targets cannot move or use Skills, take reduced damage from attacks (75%), and their Skill Cooldowns will be stopped.
Accuracy required for: Freeze
#1 Damage: 235% ATK
INVOKATION END

bio: Sionach was born from the great, all-encompassing debates between the burning spirit of the Eldrin's Wild Kings and the cold logic of the Royal Conclave. Its weapon is testament to this clash of tempers – with its glaive able to singe and freeze foes in equal measure.
